name: bugfix-swarm
description: USER-GATED read-only static-analysis bug-hunt swarm. A human opens a run; waves of hunter and adversarial-verifier subagents write report files and return envelopes; a dedupe agent merges them into one findings report; the human decides every repair at a picker; executor agents fix what was accepted and verify by live execution. The registry is the kata issue tracker. Never load autonomously — the human opens every run.
